_about: Our own components, registered with a reason (the rule: every UI component comes from the catalogue; a custom one is added here before it ships). Library picks are in picks.json.

siso:agent-notification-row.reason: You asked for these owner pop-ups; approved bank 'good'. Face, title, the ask, react, reply in one row. No library row does this.

siso:person-card.reason: Who, state, what they hold, last report, plan progress: our domain. Rides on arc:hover-card timing.

siso:stat-tile.reason: The S widget: value, unit, label, delta tone, and it is a button (a tile that filters). Token-based, 35 lines.

siso:status-badge.reason: Live/idle/error with reduced-motion handled; on 42 Operator pages. ADR 9.

siso:empty-state.reason: Whole-page empty with our own 13 drawings and one next step.

siso:kit-base-ui.from: operator ui/ (Popover, Tabs, HubTabs, ConfirmDialog, MonthCalendar)
siso:kit-base-ui.reason: Thin token wrappers on Base UI; already what the catalogue asks for. Kept, not swapped.

siso:type-city.reason: Home's 3D top band: every type the libraries share as a city of towers on the landing page's isometric glass slab (UiHubIcon), height = parts, colour = SISO status; the search lives in it and lights the matching towers. Nothing in the 104k does a searchable map of a whole component corpus.

siso:page-siso-set.reason: The SISO side: shells taken apart into swappable parts with every app's way of doing each, then the map of every category with what our apps use and the best of the 104k; Take/Skip are bookmarks agents read.

siso:ontology.reason: The library by scale: every part placed on one node of catalogue/schema/ontology.json (atoms, components, sections, pages, looks) when the index loads

siso:page-node.reason: One node of the ontology at /x/<scale>/<node>: its job, made of, used in, a page's sections in order, then its parts with type, look and fit chips

siso:pick-deck.reason: The pick deck: one SISO skeleton slot at a time, its candidates in a 3D row; arrows flip, Enter takes as SISO base, X skips

siso:knowledge.reason: No library pick loads the hub's own per-node knowledge file (variations, notes, taste, papers, use cases); it is hub plumbing, not a UI part

siso:page-papers.reason: No pick renders SISO's own white papers and research library; built from our list and link primitives in the hub's look

siso:start-here.reason: Home's start-here: how the scales fit together, where takes/skips/saves land, what the research taught us, use cases to pick from; no library block explains our own ontology and bookmarks

siso:page-ours.reason: Our own apps' parts pictured from their real screens, by app and slot, with a pick deck; no library has our apps

siso:page-map.reason: The lay of the land: every part SISO needs by scale, lit by what a chosen library covers, with a second to compare; no library maps itself onto our ontology

siso:page-vs.reason: Two libraries like for like: each part read for its job and placed on our skeleton; only jobs both do are questions; previews in place

siso:app-frame.reason: One SISO app frame instead of 87 near-identical sidebars and app shells. Always there: search with a ⌘K palette, counts on items, the collapse button up top, animated icons on every row. 8 choices: layout (sidebar or rail + panel), look, collapse, switcher (workspaces or views), tools (none/4/6, each swaps the nav), nav, bottom, top bar; rail + panel rules out the bad pairs (no tools strip, switcher or bottom in the panel; it only slides away). Style tokens (scheme, matte or glass, font, radius) in frame-tokens.ts. 54 named variations in catalogue/app-frame.json; starts from SISO, HALO CRM, SISO CRM, Agent Base or Custom

siso:page-wire.reason: A page type drawn as a wireframe from its recipe (shell, header, blocks, overlays), each block lit on hover; no library draws a page skeleton from a recipe list

siso:page-kit-map.reason: The kit map as one screen: the which-level ladder, families as columns that scroll sideways, the kind under the pointer read out at the foot

siso:page-kit-pages.reason: Page types as wire cards you click into; the detail page lights each recipe block and lists our pages of that type

siso:facet-menu.reason: One filter as one button with its value and a clear x; open, the choices with counts, biggest first, found by typing (Arc popover + the hub's command list). Replaces rows of filter chips that pushed parts off the first screen

siso:page-kit-dashboard.reason: Dashboard kit: every chart, stat and data part live, one row per kind, Keep/Skip saved as bookmarks agents read with uihub kit

siso:kit-slot.reason: The slot a library node page is filling; cards under it get Add to kit, writing the same siso/base pick as the SISO set

siso:families.reason: Taxonomy v2: Layer > Family > Kind > Variation over the ontology's node keys (catalogue/schema/families.json), stub kinds for wants the library has no category for, and the kit dot state per kind

siso:kit-dot.reason: One mark for how full a kind is in the SISO kit (full, base picked, gap), used in the side nav, kind tiles and crumbs (spec C2)

siso:stage.reason: One part live at real size with width, reload, fullscreen and sound/image/video modes; the component page and the kind page's kit pick both use it (spec C3)

siso:slot-strip.reason: A kind's base and variation slots, filled or a gap, in the sisolabs landing's tab rail; the selected slot is where Add to kit writes (spec C4)

siso:part-code.reason: A part's install lines and code under the Stage on a kind page, with line counts and copy (specs C9, C10)

siso:kind-tile.reason: One kind as a tile: a real screen of the kit's pick (or a strong library part while it is a gap), kit dot, name, part count (spec C7)

siso:family-band.reason: One family on a layer page: overline with how full it is in the kit, its job, its kinds as tiles (spec C6)

siso:layer-band.reason: The kit home's first row: each layer of the SISO kit with four real screens and kinds in the kit (spec T1)

siso:page-kit-layer.reason: A layer of the SISO kit: every family as a band of kind tiles with real screens, how full each is, and Shuffle for the gaps (spec T2)

siso:widget-board.from: halo-streaming v2/ui/src/widgets (her Dashboard boards, the Operator's Performance grid)
siso:widget-board.reason: The hub has no widget board: cards a person arranges, sizes and folds, kept per page (LANE-6-UI section 3).

siso:platform-glyph.reason: Each cam site's own mark (Chaturbate, Stripchat, CamSoda and the rest): brand marks no icon library carries.

siso:ok-card.reason: The Operator's default, accent and flat card API; one Card API with hers waits for Phase B.

siso:list-row.reason: Her list row over the item parts: a leading mark, two lines and a trailing value, across her Dashboard.

siso:seg.from: halo-streaming v2/ui/src/segmented/seg.tsx (the Operator's Direction B Seg)
siso:seg.reason: The Operator's count switch with key caps and a priority tag; folds onto arc:segmented-control in Phase B.

siso:percent-slider.reason: A 0-100 split slider with its value label, a thin wrapper over the slider.

siso:page-tabs.reason: Her page tab bar on Base UI Tabs with its sliding pill; arc:tabs's look waits for Phase B.

siso:quiet-segmented.reason: Her quiet toggle row keeps its own look in Phase A; folds onto arc:segmented-control in Phase B.
